prompt: What does the host say about people who did not bring seeds?
promptZh: 主持人對沒有帶種子的人怎麼說？
evidence: You may take two, even if you did not bring seeds today.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: You may take two, even if you did not bring seeds today.

options.text: They may still take two packets.
options.whyZh: 一開始明確說即使沒帶種子也可以拿兩袋。

options.text: They must wait until the next event.
options.zh: 他們必須等到下次活動。
options.whyZh: 沒有帶種子不影響今天拿兩袋的資格。

options.text: They may only take blank envelopes.
options.whyZh: 空信封另外放在出口，沒帶種子也能拿主桌種子袋。

options.text: They should volunteer at the check-in desk.
options.zh: 他們應在報到櫃檯當志工。
options.whyZh: 沒有帶種子的人不需要以擔任志工作為條件。

explanationZh: 一開始明確說即使沒帶種子也可以拿兩袋。

vocabulary.note: 指用來裝種子的小紙袋或包裝。
